seed_purpose: Verified taxonomy seed for rebuilding fracture FCR definitions from NASA-STD-5019A w/Change 4. Descriptions are paraphrased summaries, not verbatim requirement text.
notes: Use this as a clean seed for rebuilding fcr_definitions.json and fcr_applicability.json.
FCR 21 and FCR 22 apply to fracture-critical parts and NFC composite/bonded parts, not to all NFC parts.
The KIc/Fty >= 0.33 sqrt(in) rule belongs to FCR 8 section 6.2.5.a(2) for metallic NFC low-risk parts, not to general FCR 22.

fcrs.title: FCP development and maintenance
fcrs.summary: Requires a fracture control plan for human-rated spaceflight hardware.

fcrs.title: NASA implementation
fcrs.summary: Requires NASA center implementation through the responsible fracture control board.

fcrs.title: Program implementation
fcrs.summary: Requires human-rated programs to impose fracture control on their projects.

fcrs.title: RFCB involvement
fcrs.summary: Requires fracture control implementation with RFCB oversight, advice, and approval.

fcrs.title: Evaluate all parts for classification
fcrs.summary: Requires all parts to be evaluated as exempt, NFC, or fracture critical.

fcrs.title: Exempt classification criteria
fcrs.summary: Defines the conditions under which a part may be classified as exempt.

fcrs.title: Established approaches for specific NFC hardware types
fcrs.summary: Defines NFC qualification paths for specific hardware types such as fasteners, shatterable parts, rotating hardware, sealed containers, tools, and batteries.

fcrs.title: General NFC approaches
fcrs.summary: Defines general NFC categories including low-released mass, contained, fail-safe, NHLBB, low-risk, and documented non-hazardous failure modes.

fcrs.title: Additional activities for NFC composite or bonded hardware
fcrs.summary: Adds composite or bonded NFC activities such as DTA, IDMP, RTD, NDE, traceability, and material requirements.

fcrs.title: Fracture-critical classification criteria
fcrs.summary: Defines when a part must be classified as fracture critical.

fcrs.title: Established approaches for specific fracture-critical hardware types
fcrs.summary: Defines required approaches for specific fracture-critical hardware categories such as pressure vessels, COPVs, lines and fittings, structures, rotating hardware, fasteners, shatterable hardware, tools, and batteries.

fcrs.title: General approach for metallic fracture-critical parts
fcrs.summary: Defines loading spectra and assessment by analysis and/or test for metallic fracture-critical parts not covered by established or optional approaches.

fcrs.title: General approach for composite or bonded fracture-critical parts
fcrs.summary: Defines DTA, IDMP, RTD, loading, test, and assessment requirements for composite or bonded fracture-critical parts not covered elsewhere.

fcrs.title: Optional fracture-critical approaches
fcrs.summary: Defines optional approved approaches for special fracture-critical cases not covered by section 7.2.

fcrs.title: Flaw screen requirement
fcrs.summary: Requires all fracture-critical parts to be screened for flaws with methods identified in the fracture control plan.

fcrs.title: NDE for metallic parts
fcrs.summary: Defines metallic-part NDE requirements for flaw screening and post-proof-test inspections.

fcrs.title: NDE for composite or bonded parts
fcrs.summary: Defines NDE methodology and screening requirements for composite or bonded hardware, including NFC exceptions.

fcrs.title: Optional proof test
fcrs.summary: Defines the conditions under which proof testing may be used as the flaw-screening technique.

fcrs.title: Optional process controls
fcrs.summary: Defines when process controls may be used to bound flaw sizes in fracture-critical parts.

fcrs.title: Detected flaw assessment
fcrs.summary: Defines assessment requirements for hardware with detected flaws that will be flown without repair or replacement.

fcrs.title: Traceability requirement
fcrs.summary: Requires traceability for fracture-critical parts and NFC composite or bonded parts.

fcrs.title: Materials selection and usage requirement
fcrs.summary: Defines material selection, processing, property, and MUA requirements for fracture-critical parts and NFC composite or bonded parts.

fcrs.title: Engineering drawing identification requirement
fcrs.summary: Requires fracture-critical parts to be identified on engineering drawings with inspection, serialization, and other traceability information.

fcrs.title: Fracture Control Summary Report requirement
fcrs.summary: Requires an FCSR documenting the basis for acceptance, results, records, and disposition of flight hardware parts.

fcrs.title: Verification requirement
fcrs.summary: Requires written verification that fracture control requirements were met, including RFCB approval and conflict-resolution process.

fcrs.title: Alternative approaches requirement
fcrs.summary: Defines the conditions and exclusions for proposing alternative approaches to the standard requirements.
